# Transformers

Transformers process sequences using attention rather than recurrence.

## Why attention matters

Attention lets a model decide which parts of an input sequence are
relevant to each output position.

## Notes

- Tokens are converted into vectors.
- Attention compares those vectors.
- The result is used to build a contextual representation.
